source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Αβραάμ ο εν τω όρει Λάτρω ασκήσας»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The entry carries no asterisk and no disclaimer, and gives no year, so there is no dates object. He is none of the men of the name the corpus already keeps — not Abraham of Carrhae, not Abraham of Smolensk, not Abraham the Industrious of the Kyiv Caves, not Abraham the Recluse and not the patriarch; this one is the ascetic of Mount Latros in Asia Minor.
